title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Added RAG/agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; docs site update with new quickstart nav and example playground.
description: Context: Add a set of first-party RAG templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and minor docs site updates to make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG + tool-calling flows. Motivation: internal and external customers repeatedly ask for canonical quickstarts that show the end-to-end flow (ingest -> vector index -> tool calling + fallback). This PR bundles templates, runnable examples (Python + TS), and docs site navigation/quickstart pages so the content is discoverable from the main docs nav. Checklist: - [x] RAG agent templates (templates/rag/*) - [x] Python quickstart (examples/rag/python_quickstart.py) - [x] TypeScript quickstart (examples/rag/ts_quickstart.md & samples) - [x] Tool-calling examples demonstrating search+custom-tool integration - [x] Docs site updates (redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag) - [x] E2E local run instructions and tests - [x] Unit test coverage for the example harness Commits summary: 1) add rag agent templates and template metadata (commit 1 of 5) 2) add python quickstart with example prompts and README (commit 2 of 5) 3) add typescript quickstart & sample harness (commit 3 of 5) 4) docs site pages, nav updates, and redirects (commit 4 of 5) 5) fix CI issues, test flakiness, and finalize copy (commit 5 of 5) Changed areas (high-level): - redwood-examples/rag/templates/*: new RAG agent templates (retrieval-first, retrieval-with-tool-calling, multi-source-fusion) - redwood-examples/rag/python_quickstart.py: runnable quickstart showcasing vector index setup, prompt templates, and agent instantiation - redwood-examples/rag/ts_quickstart.md and samples/: TS example using the SDK types for tool-calling and streaming - redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag/*: new docs pages, screen grabs, and example snippets - redwood-docs/static/playground/*: small JS to wire examples into the docs playground - tests/examples/rag_test.py and tests/examples/ts_rag_test.sh: basic smoke tests Review conversation highlights: - Miguel Ramirez: "Nice set of examples. Can we make the Python quickstart show the minimal config to enable prefix caching? Also call out the recommended production model variant." Aisha: "Added a short section and inline comment about prefix caching and linked the model-variant guide." - Sofia Nguyen: "Docs nav looks good but the redirect rule will conflict with an existing quickstart slug. Please use /quickstarts/rag/overview and set a redirect." Aisha: "Adjusted nav and added redirect file; pushed updated commit." - Ethan Brooks (QA): "Found a flaky test in ts_rag_test.sh on CI that times out on CI GPU machines." Aisha: "Increased the test timeout and added a small retry loop for network-dependent steps; re-ran CI." CI details: Initial CI run queued with lint and unit tests; lint had one minor markdown link fix that was auto-applied by pre-commit hook. First test run had a transient failure in ts_rag_test.sh (timeout) which was fixed in follow-up commit. Final CI status: pass across all checks (lint, unit, e2e-smoke). Notes on docs/content: The docs additions include a concise RAG conceptual explainer, step-by-step quickstarts for Python and TypeScript, and a new "Tool calling patterns with RAG" section that demonstrates safe tool invocation, input validation, and example fallback strategies. Backwards compatibility: No breaking API changes; this is docs + examples only. Migration notes: N/A Testing performed: Local E2E smoke run for Python quickstart against local vector store; TS examples built in a headless CI job. Files changed and small snippets (illustrative): - redwood-examples/rag/templates/retrieval-with-tool-calling.yaml: small template describing retrieval pipeline and tool binding - redwood-examples/rag/python_quickstart.py: shows client = RedwoodClient(...); agent = Agent.from_template(...); response = agent.run(user_prompt) - redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag/overview.md: added quickstart walkthrough and screenshots Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main after approvals from Miguel and Sofia and green CI. Post-merge actions: - Publish docs site (netlify/github actions) — docs deploy triggered automatically on merge - Announce in #dev-examples with links to runnable examples - Add sample owners for examples (OWNERS file) Future work: - Add a more advanced example showing batching and prefix cache tuning - Add integration with the dedicated indexer for large corpora - Add additional language examples (Go) Credits: Authored by Aisha Patel; reviews by Miguel Ramirez, Sofia Nguyen, and Ethan Brooks.
notes: Docs deploy triggered; owners added; follow-ups tracked in ENG-3402
